title: A* Pathfinding
tagline: A node-based A* implementation for 2D Unity games with a grid generator that reads the Tilemap.
overview: An A* implementation that computes paths over a node grid for 2D games, plus a custom tool to generate that grid from a defined area, taking walls and obstacles from Unity's Tilemap.

highlights.title: A* on a node grid
highlights.text: Efficient path calculation from a start to a goal.

highlights.title: Grid generator
highlights.text: Define the area and generate the grid integrated with the Tilemap.

highlights.title: Obstacle detection
highlights.text: Walls and obstacles are detected automatically.

learnings: Implementing and optimizing A* for grid environments.
Building a tool to speed up level design.
